name: Traditional Shikakai Herbal Powder
shortDescription: A time-tested herbal blend for naturally strong, clean, and lustrous hair.
description: Inspired by generations of natural hair care, our Shikakai Herbal Powder is a complete traditional solution for hair wash. Made with locally sourced shikakai, amla, reetha, and a blend of restorative herbs, it cleanses the scalp gently without stripping natural oils.
howToUse: Mix the required amount of powder with water to form a paste.
Apply evenly on wet hair and scalp.
storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place in an airtight container.
